title: 第30章 夜行恶鬼
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
帝王寝殿门口。

    青符握着铜板怔怔发愣。

    过了许久，他缓过神，神识急忙扫向寝殿内。

    偌大的床榻之上，此刻已经空了。

    青符站在原地，脸色阴沉如水。

    “人居然消失了！”

    “人怎么会在本座眼皮子底下，不声不响地消失！”

    忽然，青符想到了近些日子以来，云江仙的不寻常。

    一个惊悚的念头，在他心底骤然浮现。

    “莫非…”

    “莫非！！刚刚那道鬼影是云江仙！？”

    ……

    无尽黑夜中。

    一道鬼影隐匿于黑暗，气息全敛，如幽灵般避开了所有帝宫禁卫。

    鬼影所过之处，黑暗变得格外浓稠，所有光线消失、声音与神识隔绝，宛如一片移动的幽寂地狱。

    循着空气中的诱人香味，鬼影很快出现在了一座院落旁。

    梦妃宫！

    此刻，鬼影眼中露出一抹挣扎之色。

    秦然意图摆脱身上的邪恶和戾气，意图恢复理智，但身上的戾气之强，远远超出了他的掌控。

    没坚持一会儿，他的意识便再度被邪恶之力影响，整个人极度癫狂，半昏半醒……

    他猛地抬起头，眼中血光滔天。

    目光穿透黑暗、穿透墙壁，落在了院落最深处的房间当中。

    “嘿嘿，特殊灵体的诱人香味……”

    呼。

    他踏前两步，身形穿过墙壁，无声无息出现在院落里。

    门口的两个剑侍没有丝毫察觉。

    噗！噗！！

    两道利刃入肉声在深夜里响起。

    两只干枯鬼爪，深深刺入剑侍心脏当中，稍一用力，跳动的心脏砰的一声，如桃子般炸开。

    剑侍体内，法相境道基化成灵力，一窝蜂地被吸入鬼爪当中……

    “唔～舒服。”

    黑影口中发出愉悦呻吟。

    心脏深处的黑潭中，刚吞噬的灵力化成潭水，让平静水面上涨了半分。

    “谁！！”

    此处的轻微响动，引起了内院四个剑侍的注意。

    黑夜中，四道白影踏空而来，成合围之势，将鬼影围于中间。

    看着鬼影的骇人样貌。

    四个法相境巅峰剑侍皆是心弦一紧。

    “列阵！”

    “四象剑阵！！”

    “嘿嘿，列你奶奶个腿。”鬼影邪笑着，如鬼魂般消失在原地。

    下一刻，再度出现时，已然到了一个剑侍的身后。

    “小心！！”另外三个剑侍骇然色变。
content_en:
The entrance to the emperor's bedroom.

    Qing Fu held the copper plate in a daze.

    After a long time, he calmed down and his consciousness hurriedly swept towards the dormitory.

    The huge bed was now empty.

    Qing Fu stood there, his face as gloomy as water.

    "People actually disappeared!"

    "How could a person disappear quietly under my nose?"

    Suddenly, Qing Fu thought of Yun Jiangxian's unusual behavior in recent days.

    A horrifying thought suddenly appeared in his heart.

    "Could it be..."

    "Could it be?! That ghostly figure just now was Yun Jiangxian!?"

    …

    In the endless darkness.

    A ghost figure hid in the darkness, its aura completely restrained, and it avoided all the Imperial Palace guards like a ghost.

    Wherever the ghost passed, the darkness became extraordinarily thick, all light disappeared, sound and consciousness were cut off, like a moving and silent hell.

    Following the alluring fragrance in the air, the ghost soon appeared next to a courtyard.

    Mengfei Palace!

    At this moment, there was a look of struggle in Guiying's eyes.

    Qin Ran intended to get rid of the evil and violent energy in his body and regain his sanity, but the violent energy in his body was far beyond his control.

    After not persisting for a while, his consciousness was once again affected by the evil force, and he was extremely crazy and half-conscious...

    He raised his head suddenly, his eyes filled with blood.

    His gaze penetrated the darkness, penetrated the wall, and landed in the deepest room in the courtyard.

    "Hey, the alluring scent of a special spirit..."

    Phew.

    He took two steps forward, passed through the wall, and appeared in the courtyard silently.

    The two swordsmen at the door didn't notice at all.

    puff! puff! !

    The sound of two sharp knives entering flesh sounded in the middle of the night.

    The two withered ghost claws pierced deeply into the sword servant's heart. With a little force, the beating heart exploded like a peach.

    In the body of the sword servant, the Dharma Realm Dao Foundation turned into spiritual power, and was sucked into the ghost claws one by one...

    "Hmm~ It's comfortable."

    The shadow moaned in pleasure.

    In the black pool deep in his heart, the spiritual power he had just swallowed turned into water, causing the calm water surface to rise by half a minute.

    "Who!!"

    The slight noise here attracted the attention of the four swordsmen in the inner courtyard.

    In the dark night, four white shadows came through the air and formed an encirclement, surrounding the ghost shadow in the middle.

    Look at the terrifying appearance of the ghost.

    The four swordsmen at the peak of Dharma Realm all felt their hearts tighten.

    "Array up!"

    "Four Elephants Sword Formation!!"

    "Hey, let me help your grandma." The ghost smiled evilly and disappeared like a ghost.

    The next moment, when he reappeared, he was already behind a sword attendant.

    "Be careful!!" The expressions of the other three swordsmen changed in horror.
